orthologs.method: DIAMOND reciprocal best hit vs TAIR10, identity >=50%
orthologs.replaces: a 100-byte file containing a BioMart error

kegg_brp.id_space: NCBI GeneID; joins 0 of this repo's Bra###### counts

kegg_via_arabidopsis.why: KEGG ath is keyed on AGI codes, which the ortholog map already emits, so Bra###### -> AT#G##### -> pathway joins with no bridging step. KEGG brp is keyed on NCBI GeneID and cannot join to this repo's counts.
